title: Closed subgroups of profinite groups are intersections of open overgroups
statement: Let $G$ be a profinite topological group in the sense of [lem-galois-aut-profinite] (compact and totally disconnected), and let $H$ be a closed subgroup. Then, as subgroups of $G$, $H$ equals the infimum (intersection) of all open subgroups $N$ of $G$ that contain $H$. In particular, if $H\ne G$, some proper open subgroup contains $H$.
